fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 6 months after the date you arrive.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento al menos 6 meses posterior a la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: To enter Antigua and Barbuda, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 6 months after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You can visit without a visa and be allowed to stay for a maximum of 90 days.
entry.es: Se puede visitar sin visado y se permite una estancia máxima de 90 días.
entry.quote: You can visit Antigua and Barbuda without a visa. On entry, you’ll be allowed to stay for a maximum period of 90 days.

entry.en: Visitors must be able to show an onward or return ticket to enter the country.
entry.es: Los visitantes deben poder mostrar un billete de salida o regreso para entrar al país.
entry.quote: Visitors must be able to show an onward or return ticket in order to enter the country.

entry.en: Authorities advise using ArriveAntigua.com to speed up entry, though it is not mandatory.
entry.es: Las autoridades aconsejan usar ArriveAntigua.com para agilizar la entrada, aunque no es obligatorio.
entry.quote: The Antiguan and Barbudan authorities advise travellers to use ArriveAntigua.com to speed up your entry into the country, though it is not mandatory.

entry.en: A yellow fever vaccination certificate is required if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Se exige certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si se llega desde un país considerado de riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.
entry.es: Hay que declarar todo lo que pueda estar prohibido o sujeto a impuestos o aranceles.
entry.quote: You must declare anything that may be prohibited or subject to tax or duty.

safety.en: There have been incidents of violent crime including murder, armed robbery and sexual assault.
safety.es: Ha habido incidentes de delitos violentos, incluidos asesinatos, robos a mano armada y agresiones sexuales.
safety.quote: There have been incidents of violent crime including murder, armed robbery and sexual assault in Antigua and Barbuda.

safety.en: The advice is to avoid isolated areas, including beaches, particularly after dark.
safety.es: Se aconseja evitar zonas aisladas, incluidas las playas, sobre todo después de anochecer.
safety.quote: avoid isolated areas, including beaches, particularly after dark

safety.en: The hurricane season in the Caribbean normally runs from June to November.
safety.es: La temporada de huracanes en el Caribe suele ir de junio a noviembre.
safety.quote: The hurricane season in the Caribbean normally runs from June to November.

safety.en: Earthquakes are a risk in Antigua and Barbuda.
safety.es: Los terremotos son un riesgo en Antigua y Barbuda.
safety.quote: Earthquakes are a risk in Antigua and Barbuda.

safety.en: Currents can be deceptively strong and not all beaches have lifeguards or warning flags.
safety.es: Las corrientes pueden ser engañosamente fuertes y no todas las playas tienen socorristas o banderas de aviso.
safety.quote: Currents can be deceptively strong and not all beaches have lifeguards or warning flags.

safety.en: It is illegal for anyone, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing.
safety.es: Es ilegal que cualquiera, incluidos los niños, vista ropa de camuflaje.
safety.quote: It is illegal for anyone, including children, to dress in camouflage clothing.

health.en: The main government hospital can cope with many treatments but serious cases may need emergency evacuation.
health.es: El principal hospital público puede atender muchos tratamientos, pero los casos graves pueden requerir evacuación de emergencia.
health.quote: The main government hospital can cope with many types of treatment but serious cases may need an emergency evacuation.

health.en: Medical treatment in Antigua and Barbuda can be expensive.
health.es: El tratamiento médico en Antigua y Barbuda puede ser caro.
health.quote: Medical treatment in Antigua and Barbuda can be expensive.

health.en: Tap water can be discoloured and cause upset stomachs even after boiling, and bottled water is more reliable.
health.es: El agua del grifo puede estar descolorida y causar molestias estomacales incluso hervida; el agua embotellada es más fiable.
health.quote: Tap water can be discoloured, and cause upset stomachs even after boiling. Bottled water is more reliable.

health.en: Private clinics may not accept medical travel insurance as payment for treatment.
health.es: Las clínicas privadas pueden no aceptar el seguro médico de viaje como pago del tratamiento.
health.quote: Private clinics may not accept medical travel insurance as payment for treatment.

help.en: The emergency number is 999 or 911 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias es el 999 o el 911 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: The FCDO in London can be called for urgent help if something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar al FCDO en Londres para pedir ayuda urgente si le ha ocurrido algo a un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

getting_in.en: V.C. Bird International (ANU), near St John's, is the main international airport.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional V.C. Bird (ANU), cerca de St John's, es el principal aeropuerto internacional.
getting_in.quote: V.C. Bird International, (ANU IATA) located in north eastern Antigua on the outskirts of St John's, is the country's main international airport.

getting_in.en: Montserrat Ferry has ferries from Montserrat.
getting_in.es: Montserrat Ferry tiene transbordadores desde Montserrat.
getting_in.quote: Montserrat Ferry has ferries from Montserrat.

getting_in.en: Many visitors come in via cruise ships, and yacht charters are another alternative.
getting_in.es: Muchos visitantes llegan en cruceros, y los charters de yates son otra alternativa.
getting_in.quote: Many visitors come in via cruise ships. Yacht charters offer another alternative in and around the islands.

getting_in.en: Visitors arriving by sea must contact the Antigua Port Authority at least 6 hours before arrival on VHF Channel 16.
getting_in.es: Los visitantes que lleguen por mar deben contactar con la Autoridad Portuaria de Antigua al menos 6 horas antes por el canal VHF 16.
getting_in.quote: Visitors arriving by sea must contact the Antigua Port Authority at least 6 hours before arrival using VHF Channel 16.

getting_around.en: Tourists mainly get around by car rental or tour operators.
getting_around.es: Los turistas se desplazan sobre todo en coche de alquiler o con operadores turísticos.
getting_around.quote: Tourists mainly get around by car rental or tour operators.

getting_around.en: There is a fleet of local minibuses with about 12-14 seats that run set routes.
getting_around.es: Hay una flota de minibuses locales de unos 12-14 asientos que siguen rutas fijas.
getting_around.quote: There is however a fleet of local buses, usually minibuses with about 12-14 seats, which run set routes

getting_around.en: There is no set bus timetable but one usually passes every 10-15 minutes.
getting_around.es: No hay horario fijo de autobuses, pero suele pasar uno cada 10-15 minutos.
getting_around.quote: There is also no set timetable but one usually passes every 10-15 minutes.

getting_around.en: Barbuda Express runs ferries between Barbuda and Antigua, 2 hours and US$107 as of 2024, booked online.
getting_around.es: Barbuda Express opera transbordadores entre Barbuda y Antigua, 2 horas y 107 US$ en 2024, con reserva en línea.
getting_around.quote: Barbuda Express runs ferries between Barbuda and Antigua. 2 hours, US$107 as of 2024, book online.

getting_around.en: Taxis are not metered, fares are set by zones, and you should agree the fare in local currency before setting off.
getting_around.es: Los taxis no tienen taxímetro, las tarifas se fijan por zonas y conviene acordar el precio en moneda local antes de salir.
getting_around.quote: Taxis are not metered. Standard taxi fares are set by zones. Agree the fare in local currency with the driver before you set off.

getting_around.en: You will need a temporary local driving licence to drive in Antigua and Barbuda.
getting_around.es: Necesitas un permiso de conducir local temporal para conducir en Antigua y Barbuda.
getting_around.quote: You will need a temporary local driving licence to drive in Antigua and Barbuda.

money.en: The currency is the East Caribbean dollar (XCD).
money.es: La moneda es el dólar del Caribe Oriental (XCD).
money.quote: The currency of the country is the East Caribbean dollar, denoted by the symbol: "$" or "EC$" (ISO currency code: XCD)

money.en: The East Caribbean dollar is pegged to the US dollar at US$1 = EC$2.70.
money.es: El dólar del Caribe Oriental está vinculado al dólar estadounidense a razón de 1 US$ = 2,70 EC$.
money.quote: It is pegged to the United States dollar at an exchange rate of US$1 = EC$2.70.

money.en: You can often pay taxi fares in US dollars as well as Eastern Caribbean dollars.
money.es: A menudo se pueden pagar las tarifas de taxi en dólares estadounidenses además de dólares del Caribe Oriental.
money.quote: You can often pay in US dollars as well as Eastern Caribbean dollars.

money.en: Coins come in 1, 2, 5, 10 and 25 cents and 1 dollar, and banknotes in 10, 20, 50 and 100 dollars.
money.es: Las monedas son de 1, 2, 5, 10 y 25 centavos y 1 dólar, y los billetes de 10, 20, 50 y 100 dólares.
money.quote: Coins circulate in denominations of 1, 2, 5, 10 and 25 cents and 1 dollar. Banknotes circulate in denominations of 10, 20, 50, and 100 dollars.

etiquette.en: Locals are described as very friendly, and approaching them courteously will be returned.
etiquette.es: Se describe a los locales como muy amables, y acercarse a ellos con cortesía será correspondido.
etiquette.quote: The locals are very friendly and respectable. Approach them in a courteous manner and it will undoubtedly be returned to you.

etiquette.en: Approach locals with a smile and remember please, thank you and good afternoon.
etiquette.es: Acércate a los locales con una sonrisa y recuerda decir por favor, gracias y buenas tardes.
etiquette.quote: Approach them with a smile and remember please, thank you, good afternoon.
